block_name: Parc olympique de Montréal (Stade olympique, Tour de Montréal, Biodôme, Planétarium Rio Tinto Alcan & Esplanade)

1_overlay_band_structural_footprint_silh.summary: All 9 views (1 Satellite Top-Down + 8 Google Street View cameras) lock onto real-world silhouettes and footprints with 78.6% mean Color Sim (75.1%-81.2%) and up to 1.25x Detail Edge Ratio.

2_true_3d_architectural_hierarchy_sculpt.summary: 38 cantilevered stadium ribs, 3-zone stadium roof with turquoise-blue collar, 165m 45-degree inclined Tour de Montreal with 14 base wing skylights and 26 cables, scalloped Biodome shell with Y-ribs and 6 leaf skylights, Planetarium twin cones with green roof ramp, and 150 floor-by-floor fenestrated context buildings.

3_pbr_materiality_roof_detailing_ground_.summary: 27 distinct PBR materials with warm-beige concrete Esplanade replacing the green lawn polygon, turquoise stadium roof collar, fluted brutalist retaining walls, ivy wall cladding, and diversified context roofs.

4_high_poly_3d_foliage_street_furniture_.summary: Comprehensive street-corridor context across all 8 views including Olympic History signage panels, Rouge festival totem, container kiosk, traffic cones, curved white planter beds, and high-poly trees.

5_technical_and_z_fighting_hygiene.summary: Zero coplanar black polygons, zero highlight blowout, clean face normals, and 21 packed PBR textures.

view_by_view_audit.label: Google_Maps_Satellite_TopDown
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: All 6 satellite enhancements verified: warm-beige concrete Esplanade in H5-H8/V2-V6, 3-zone stadium roof with turquoise collar in H3-H6/V3-V6, 14 elliptical skylights on Tour de Montreal base wing in H1-H2/V3-V4, scalloped Biodome Y-ribs and 6 leaf skylights in H1-H2/V6-V7, Planetarium green roof ramp in H7/V3-V4, and diversified context roofs in V7-V8.

view_by_view_audit.label: Tour_de_Montreal_and_Biodome_South
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Curved stadium ribs (H2-H4), inclined tower crown (V4), dark gallery glazing (H4), lower canopy (H5), and tricolor Olympic History signage panels (H6) align across H1..H8 and V1..V8.

view_by_view_audit.label: Stade_Olympique_Ribs_PierreDeCoubertin
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Cantilevered rib tips (H2), curved cornice (H3), dark curtain wall with circular medallions (H3-H4), ground portals (H5), and scored concrete apron (H6-H8) align cleanly.

view_by_view_audit.label: Biodome_Velodrome_Facade_East
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Inclined tower and stadium ribs (V1-V2), Biodome lobby (V3-V4), 4-story grey-stone/red-balcony residential apartment block (V5-V8), and foreground traffic cones/planter (H5-H6) match ground truth.

view_by_view_audit.label: Esplanade_Olympique_PieIX_Approach
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Timber-slatted Rouge totem (V4-V5), white container booth (V2-V3), background stadium ribs and tower (H3-H4), and concrete Esplanade deck (H6-H8) achieve 81.2% Color Sim.

view_by_view_audit.label: PieIX_West_Stadium_and_Tower
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: 45-degree inclined tower with cable fan (V2-V4, H2-H4), western stadium rib ring (H4), concrete podium wall (H5), lawn strip (H6), and Pie-IX roadbed (H7-H8) align across bands.

view_by_view_audit.label: PieIX_NW_Tour_de_Montreal_Base
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Curved portal base and 45-degree inclined shaft of La Tour de Montreal with 8 recessed dark curtain-wall tiers (V3-V7, H1-H4), cable stays, and stepped concrete retaining walls (H5-H8) achieve 81.2% Color Sim and 1.11x Edge Ratio.

view_by_view_audit.label: Planetarium_Cones_and_Biodome_North
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Twin truncated metallic cones of the Planetarium (V3-V5, H4), sloped green roof ramp (V1-V4, H4-H5), glazed lobby (H5), and curved white concrete planter curbs (H6-H8) match closely.

view_by_view_audit.label: PierreDeCoubertin_South_Stadium_Cantilevers
view_by_view_audit.band_notes: Southern stadium rib cantilevers (H3-H4), ivy-clad green wall bastion (V5-V7, H4-H5), and foreground fluted concrete ramp retaining wall (V4-V8, H5-H8) achieve 79.8% Color Sim.

recursive_self_improvement_rule.title: Multi-Angle 8-Camera Street View + 3-Zone Nadir Roof & Hardscape Plaza Validation
recursive_self_improvement_rule.critic_rule: Rule R6 (RSI-007): Enforce a 9-View Validation Matrix (1 Satellite Top-Down + 8 perimeter/internal Street View cameras) on monumental superblocks (>250m x 250m), verifying that nadir plaza hardscapes, multi-zone stadium/shell roofs (concrete rib ring + colored collar + inner tensile membrane + podium skylights), and approach retaining walls achieve >=75% Color Sim across all 9 views.
recursive_self_improvement_rule.builder_rule: Rule B6 (RSI-007): Subdivide nadir-visible ground planes into true hardscape concrete decks, sunken lawn beds, and amphitheater rings traced from satellite_topdown.png, and model concentric roof material zones (outer ribs, colored intermediate collar, inner tensile membrane, and arrayed podium skylights) plus camera-specific foreground retaining walls, planters, and signage totems across all 8 Street View corridors.
